transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Set by the system, not by hand. Pending from the moment the trader flags the split; Done once the server has posted the Inventory Adjustment, trued up this line and released the remainder. Read-only on purpose: this is a state machine and hand-editing it would strand a held bundle. NOTE: a transactioncolumncustomfield cannot be DISABLED or INLINE in SDF, both are rejected at validation, so read-only is enforced by the Split Capture client script instead of by this definition.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Maintained automatically. Pending means the warehouse still has to do the physical split.
transactioncolumncustomfield.label: Split Status
